infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the changing room on Icebreaker.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Boreas engine room keycard (ER) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A Paradigm Shipping keycard granting access to technical areas of the Icebreaker. It may help reach the engine room.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be put inside secure containers

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the story chapter Boreas

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text: In the hands or next to the head of the body on level 0 of Icebreaker. A single keycard is guaranteed to spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the changing room on level 0 of Icebreaker.

sections.heading: Behind The Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Sports bag
- Loose loot (Valuables, Provisions, Medical supplies, Medical items, Stimulants)
